extraction.title: Span Buffer Multiprocess Enhancement with Health Monitoring
extraction.head: span-flusher-multiprocess

greptile.text: Paraphrase: The PR converts span processing from one process to multiple configurable processes. SpanFlusher distributes shards round-robin across processes, and each process group gets its own SpansBuffer. It adds a --flusher-processes CLI option (default 1), per-process health monitoring with automatic restart, and shard-tagged metrics. Confidence score is 2/5, citing race conditions in restart logic, inconsistent metric naming, incomplete shutdown.

Paraphrase: Metric tag naming is inconsistent. Line 185 uses the tag key 'shard' while line 199 uses 'shards' for the same shard_tag value. Suggested change: use the 'shard' key consistently for the produce timer, segment size timing, and wait_produce timer.
Paraphrase: Process termination only handles multiprocessing.Process instances and does not clean up threading.Thread objects.

Paraphrase: The style note says these assertions check the same value, since flusher.max_processes and flusher.num_processes both equal 2. It suggests removing the redundant assertion or adding a comment explaining why both are needed.
